guitar.notes: Well-documented — should not have been unknown.

tone.target: raw bright punk crunch with harsh upper mids
tone.profile: raw bright punk crunch with harsh upper mids
tone.summary: A raw, aggressive punk tone built around a British-style amp simulation (UK 45) and tight overdrive (Green OD), emphasizing brittle treble and mid-range bite.
corrections: push raw amp crunch over pedal grit

rig.name: Sex Pistols - Pretty Vacant - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain punk noise and hum.
Provide tight, aggressive overdrive without the warmth of a Tube Screamer.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD for its slightly sharper bite, mimicking early punk crunch. No specific pedal model was given, so this provides necessary grit.

alternatives.reason: A more general overdrive option if Green OD proves too aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Add aggressive bite and upper-mid punch required for punk crunch.
blocks.gap: While the Green OD handles the core grit, a secondary distortion stage (RAT-style) is used to achieve the 'harsh upper mids' and brittle treble specified in the verdict.

alternatives.reason: A more general high-gain option if RAT-style is too aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Plexi/Marshall-style amp and provide the necessary British rock foundation.

alternatives.reason: A slightly different flavor of classic UK tone, but UK 45 is closer to the Plexi vibe.

blocks.purpose: Match the specified '4x12' cabinet clue and provide a classic British voicing.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative for general UK rock tones.

blocks.purpose: Sculpt the tone to emphasize upper mids and brittle treble while tightening up the low end.
No wah effect needed for the raw punk sound.
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly avoids complex effects and focuses on raw aggression.

blocks.purpose: Avoid chorus and vibrato as requested by the verdict.
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly avoids modulation effects like Chorus/Vibrato.

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal, natural ambience without sounding deep or overly processed.
blocks.gap: Deep reverb is avoided, so a subtle Room setting is used only to prevent the tone from being completely dry and sterile.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more controlled ambience than Room.

blocks.purpose: Final output level control to ensure the raw punk crunch is audible and punchy.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and punch by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, British-voiced 4x12.

proposals.reason: Enhance punch and upper-mid bite for raw punk sound.
